prediction.question: 刺客の手を逃れたザイドとレイラ、次の一手は？
options: 隠れ家へ辿り着き、星図の解析を始める
追っ手を逆手に取り、砂嵐の中へ誘い込む
実はレイラが刺客と内通していたことが判明

en.title: Empire of Dust, Testament of the Stars
en.premise: The sudden death of the Emperor ignites a bloody struggle for the imperial throne. The key to power lies in the 'Forbidden Star Chart,' a relic left by an ancient astronomer that reveals the true borders of the realm and the location of a hidden treasure. From the depths of desert oases to the heights of the imperial court, exiled nobles and power-hungry officials clash in a high-stakes game of strategy where the fate of the nation hangs in the balance.

zh.title: 砂尘之帝国，星之遗言
zh.premise: 皇帝猝死，引发了一场围绕帝国继承权的血腥权力斗争。而掌握局势的关键，则是古代天文学家留下的“禁忌星图”——它揭示了领土的真实边界与秘宝的所在。潜伏在沙漠绿洲的亡命贵族与宫廷权臣们，在赌上国家命运的智略博弈中激烈碰撞。
